introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Protecting your personal data is a priority for Nomli. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your data.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
dataCollected.content:
We collect the following data:

• Account data: name, email, profile picture and profile picture with your van's license plate
• Location data: geographic position (with your explicit consent)
• Travel data: itineraries, stops, travel photos
• Communication data: messages, help requests
• Technical data: device type, operating system, connection logs

dataUsage.title: 3. Data Usage
dataUsage.content:
Your data is used to:

• Provide and improve our services
• Connect you with other users
• Display your location on the map (with your consent)
• Personalize your experience
• Ensure application security
• Send you important notifications

We never sell your data to third parties.

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content:
Your data may be shared with:

• Other users: public profile, location (if enabled), shared content
• Technical providers: hosting (Supabase), authentication
• Legal authorities: in case of legal or judicial request

We never share your data for marketing purposes without your consent.

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.content:
Your data is retained as long as your account is active. In case of account deletion:

• Your personal data is deleted within 30 days
• Some data may be retained for legal reasons
• Anonymized content may be retained for statistical purposes

rights.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.content:
In accordance with GDPR, you have the following rights:

• Right of access to your data
• Right of rectification
• Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
• Right to portability
• Right to object to processing
• Right to restriction of processing

To exercise your rights, contact us at: app.nomli@gmail.com

security.title: 7. Security
security.content:
We implement appropriate security measures to protect your data:

• Encryption of data in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
• Secure authentication
• Restricted access to sensitive data
• Regular security audits

However, no system is completely secure. We recommend protecting your credentials.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.content:
Nomli uses local storage technologies to:

• Maintain your logged-in session
• Remember your preferences
• Improve application performance

You can disable these features in your device settings.

minors.title: 9. Minimum Age
minors.content: Nomli is reserved for users aged 18 and over.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.content:
For any questions regarding this privacy policy or your personal data, contact us:

Email: app.nomli@gmail.com
